info.description:

request.description: Deletes (resolves) a single data scan result, marking it as reviewed. **Enterprise feature.**

header.description: Added as a part of security scheme: bearer
Added as a part of security scheme: bearer

request.description: Creates a job to export data scan results to CSV. The exported file includes scan name, workspace, database, table, field, row ID, matched value, and timestamps for each result. **Enterprise feature.**

header.description: Added as a part of security scheme: bearer
Added as a part of security scheme: bearer

query.description: A comma-separated list of data scan results IDs to filter by. When provided, only data scan results with those IDs are returned.
Defines which page should be returned.
If provided only data scan results with matched_value that match the query will be returned.
Defines how many data scan results should be returned per page.

A comma separated string of attributes to sort by, each attribute must be prefixed with `+` for a descending sort or a `-` for an ascending sort. The accepted attribute names are: `first_identified_on, last_identified_on`. For example `sorts=-first_identified_on,-last_identified_on` will sort the data scan results first by descending first_identified_on and then ascending last_identified_on. A sortparameter with multiple instances of the same sort attribute will respond with the ERROR_INVALID_SORT_ATTRIBUTE error.

request.description: Lists all data scan results across all scans. Results represent individual matches found in database fields during scan execution. Can be filtered by scan_id and searched by matched value. **Enterprise feature.**

query.description: A comma-separated list of data scans IDs to filter by. When provided, only data scans with those IDs are returned.
Defines which page should be returned.
If provided only data scans with name that match the query will be returned.
Defines how many data scans should be returned per page.

A comma separated string of attributes to sort by, each attribute must be prefixed with `+` for a descending sort or a `-` for an ascending sort. The accepted attribute names are: `name, scan_type, frequency, created_on`. For example `sorts=-name,-scan_type` will sort the data scans first by descending name and then ascending scan_type. A sortparameter with multiple instances of the same sort attribute will respond with the ERROR_INVALID_SORT_ATTRIBUTE error.

request.description: Lists all data scans configured for this Baserow instance. Data scans allow administrators to search the entire instance for sensitive data matching a pattern, a list of uploaded values, or values from another Baserow table. **Enterprise feature.**
